It is transferable to the query’s likely passive permeability problem.

The supportive records mostly involve much more lipophilic scaffolds than the query, while C09 is more representative of the query’s polar character.

The guanidine-containing C10 transfers only partially because its trityl group provides lipophilicity absent in the query. C09 transfers more directly because it captures the problem of a small polar basic molecule with limited passive BBB penetration. The query is also a close structural homolog of guanethidine, a guanidine-containing peripheral agent known to have poor CNS penetration.

The polar guanidine and lack of a large lipophilic surface make meaningful BBB penetration unlikely, despite the azepane ring. Therefore the label is fail.
